title: Representable presheaves satisfy fpqc descent
statement: Let $T$ and $X$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $(f_i:T_i\to T)$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For every $i,j$ form the fibre product $T_i\times_T T_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_1$ and $p_2$. Suppose scheme morphisms $\varphi_i:T_i\to X$ satisfy $\varphi_i\circ p_1=\varphi_j\circ p_2$ for every $i,j$. Then there is a unique scheme morphism $\varphi:T\to X$ satisfying $\varphi\circ f_i=\varphi_i$ for every $i$. Here pullback of a morphism into $X$ along any map means composition with that map, so these equations specify both compatibility and restriction explicitly.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: `instance : fpqcTopology.Subcanonical` (Fpqc.lean:87), with fpqcTopology the topology generated by fpqcPrecoverage, which is the leaf of [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For a scheme X, `GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical.isSheaf_of_isRepresentable (yoneda.obj X)` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Canonical.lean:151) gives that h_X is a sheaf; for an fpqc covering (f_i : T_i -> T), `Presieve.ofArrows T_i f_i ∈ fpqcPrecoverage T` (presieve₀_mem_qcPrecoverage_iff, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/QuasiCompact.lean:53, any index universe), so `IsSheaf.isSheafFor` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafOfTypes.lean:80) with `Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/PrecoverageToGrothendieck.lean:71) gives IsSheafFor (yoneda.obj X) (ofArrows T_i f_i); `Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff_pullbacks` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/IsSheafFor.lean:968; schemes have pullbacks) turns it into: for every family φ_i : T_i ⟶ X with pullback.fst (f i) (f j) ≫ φ_i = pullback.snd (f i) (f j) ≫ φ_j there is a unique φ : T ⟶ X with f_i ≫ φ = φ_i, which is the node's statement (yoneda.map g.op t = g ≫ t). Mathlib derives its EffectiveEpi instance (Fpqc.lean:114-119) by exactly this chain. Sources read 2026-10-10.
